d:
Lokaaastha ke mahaparv chhath ka ullas rajdhani ranchi ke bajaron men bhi dikhne laga hai. chhath parv ke sath hi apar bajar sthit bakri bajar ek bar phir paranprik sup-daura ki dukanon se guljar ho gaya hai. yahan ka bajar keval pujan samagri ki kharidari tak simit nahin hai, balki ranchi ki purani paranpra, pirhiyon se chale aa rahe karobar aur samajik sadbhav ki bhi pahchan hai.
